measurement_description: The paper and its associated benchmark, CIVICS, do not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The benchmark is designed to evaluate social and cultural variation in LLMs across value-sensitive topics such as LGBTQI rights, social welfare, immigration, disability rights, and surrogacy.
